title: stele.json
description: stele's settings, committed next to stele.md. stele reads this file and never writes it. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#stelejson

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for your editor. stele ignores it.

block_on_error.description: What happens when stele itself fails. false: the write goes through with a warning. true: the write is blocked and the agent is told why. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#stelejson

backstop.description: No longer read: use stele init --remind=off instead.
backstop.deprecationMessage: No longer read: use stele init --remind=off instead.

sources.description: Where else rules come from: another git repository ("git") or a source plugin you install. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#shared-rules-from-another-repository

checkers.description: Checker plugins you install, which stele check runs for the rules that name them. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#checker-plugins

sinks.description: Sink plugins you install, which stele push sends the log to. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#send-the-log-somewhere-stele-push

publish.description: Where stele publish sends stele.md, as a merge request. https://github.com/lictor-ai/stele#publish-the-rules-stele-publish

pluginName.description: The plugin's name: stele runs stele-<kind>-<name> found on PATH. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

timeout.description: How long one call may take, from 1s to 30m, such as "2m". Empty or unset: stele's default.

config.description: Passed to the plugin as is. Any JSON.
Passed to the sink as is. Any JSON.

share_briefs.description: Reserved: it has no effect yet.

gitSource.description: Rules from a stele.md in another git repository, read at the commit stele.lock pins.

timeout.description: Not for git, which has its own limits: leave it out.

path.description: The rules file in that repository. Default stele.md.

repo.description: A git remote: https://host/path, ssh://host/path or user@host:path. No password, and no user in an https URL.

ref.description: A branch or tag. Empty or unset: the repository's default branch.

mdPath.description: A relative path ending in .md, of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. Empty or unset: stele.md.

path.description: Where stele.md goes in that repository. Default stele.md.
